strings.name: Mustafa Suleyman
strings.role: AI entrepreneur · CEO of Microsoft AI
strings.summary: Suleyman worked on a youth helpline and public policy before co-founding DeepMind and leading applied research and commercialization. After moving to Google, he co-founded Inflection AI and wrote about technological power and governance. He joined Microsoft in 2024 and shifted toward frontier models and superintelligence research in 2026. Staff complaints about his DeepMind management led to leave; he later apologized.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founding DeepMind and advancing AI products and applications connected his work to debates over technological governance and social impact.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Studied philosophy and theology at Oxford without completing a degree.
strings.highlights.h1.title: From research to AI products
strings.highlights.h1.text: DeepMind applications and Inflection's Pi linked model research with user-facing services.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Debating technological constraints
strings.highlights.h2.text: The Coming Wave, written with Michael Bhaskar, explores powerful technologies and governance.
strings.timeline.t1.title: AI conduct draft published
strings.timeline.t1.text: Microsoft AI sought feedback on principles including human control; the draft was not yet used for model training.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Focus on frontier models
strings.timeline.t2.text: Microsoft unified Copilot product teams while he remained Microsoft AI chief, concentrating on models and superintelligence.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Joining Microsoft
strings.timeline.t3.text: Appointed EVP and Microsoft AI CEO, initially leading consumer AI products and research.
strings.timeline.t4.title: The Coming Wave published
strings.timeline.t4.text: With Bhaskar, he examined AI, biotechnology and the difficulty of containing technological diffusion.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Co-founding Inflection AI
strings.timeline.t5.text: He established the AI company with partners; it later introduced the personal assistant Pi.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Moving from DeepMind to Google
strings.timeline.t6.text: Following leave amid management complaints, he moved to AI product and policy work at Google; he later apologized for past behavior.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Google acquires DeepMind
strings.timeline.t7.text: The research company he co-founded joined Google, where he continued applications and commercialization.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Co-founding DeepMind
strings.timeline.t8.text: He established the AI research company with Demis Hassabis and Shane Legg.
